name: luna-ai-cut
description: Insta360 Luna Ultra Wi-Fi 桌面媒体管理工具
author: diamondfsd

scripts.build: node scripts/build-native.mjs && tsc && vite build && node scripts/copy-ffmpeg.mjs && node scripts/copy-dolby-tools.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.test:beauty: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-beauty-blemish-detection.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-beauty-skin-segmentation.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-video-beauty-timeline.mjs
scripts.pack:mac:arm64: node scripts/build-native.mjs && pnpm run build:app && node scripts/copy-ffmpeg.mjs --target darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/copy-dolby-tools.mjs --target darwin --arch arm64 && env -u CSC_NAME -u CSC_LINK -u CSC_KEY_PASSWORD CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_ALLOW_HARD_LINKS=false electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.pack:win:x64: node scripts/build-native.mjs && pnpm run build:app && node scripts/copy-ffmpeg.mjs --target win32 --arch x64 && node scripts/copy-dolby-tools.mjs --target win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.pack:mac:x64: CROSS_TARGET=x86_64-apple-darwin node scripts/build-native.mjs && pnpm run build:app && node scripts/copy-ffmpeg.mjs --target darwin --arch x64 && node scripts/copy-dolby-tools.mjs --target darwin --arch x64 && env -u CSC_NAME -u CSC_LINK -u CSC_KEY_PASSWORD CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_ALLOW_HARD_LINKS=false electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.pack:debug:mac:arm64: node scripts/build-native.mjs && npm run build:debug && node scripts/copy-dolby-tools.mjs --target darwin --arch arm64 && env -u CSC_NAME -u CSC_LINK -u CSC_KEY_PASSWORD CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_ALLOW_HARD_LINKS=false electron-builder --config electron-builder-debug.json5 --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.pack:debug:win:x64: node scripts/build-native.mjs && npm run build:debug && node scripts/copy-dolby-tools.mjs --target win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder-debug.json5 --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.pack:debug:mac:x64: node scripts/build-native.mjs && npm run build:debug && node scripts/copy-dolby-tools.mjs --target darwin --arch x64 && env -u CSC_NAME -u CSC_LINK -u CSC_KEY_PASSWORD CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_ALLOW_HARD_LINKS=false electron-builder --config electron-builder-debug.json5 --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
